info.title: Stock Transport Order
info.description: This service enables you to create stock transport orders through an API call from a source service outside the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system. Furthermore, the service enables you to read, update or delete stock transport orders. This service is based on the OData V4 protocol.

x-sap-shortText: Create, update, or delete stock transport orders using this synchronous service

values.text: [Stock Transfer with Delivery (BME)](https://me.sap.com/processnavigator/SolP/BME " Link To BP ")
[Stock Transfer Without Delivery (BMH)](https://me.sap.com/processnavigator/SolP/BMH " Link To BP ")
A request to move material between plants within enterprise

x-sap-extensible.description:
If you are working with key user extensibility, the API can be extended by custom fields on the following business contexts (field usage for this API needs to be selected):
* Procurement: Purchasing Document (MM_PURDOC_HEADER)
* Procurement: Purchasing Document Item (MM_PURDOC_ITEM)

[How to add an extension field to an API](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_CLOUD/0f69f8fb28ac4bf48d2b57b9637e81fa/ce819b8557194ae0aa180ba4ac6a04de.html)
